concerns.text: The specification defines a dataset contract (`specs/001-predicting-molecular-properties-from-top/contracts/dataset.schema.yaml`) but no task validates the raw ESOL CSV against this schema. Add a contract‑test task (e.g., `code/tests/test_dataset_schema.py`) that loads `data/raw/esol.csv` and validates it against `dataset.schema.yaml`, with a verification step `pytest code/tests/test_dataset_schema.py`.
